Synopsis:
The player continues to kill the rats. The rats begin to group up and attempt to bargain with the player. Their memories are starting to converge into a single consciousness of the last dark justiciar. Some players who accepted a quest from the Orthon may realise there is a Dark Justiciar in hiding, amongst these rats. If the player repeatedly talks to the rats at this point without accepting a truce, they'll turn hostile.

Cluster Contexts:
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsNegotiate.json: The player has been clearing a rat‑infested area and, after killing many rodents, the surviving rats begin to coalesce into a single, bargaining intelligence — the scattered memories of the last Dark Justiciar. Players who picked up Orthon’s quest to find a Dark Justiciar may recognize that the Justiciar’s essence is hiding among these rats. Off‑screen allies or plot beats from nearby scenes (Halsin, Auntie Ethel, companions, or the player’s illithid tadpole) might be present and influence choices, but they aren’t part of this immediate exchange. If the player repeatedly questions the rats instead of accepting a truce, the merged swarm will break off bargaining and become hostile.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsUltimatum.json: After killing too many rats, the swarm confronts the player in a chamber beneath the Orthon's lair. A fight ensues immediately afterwards.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsCalm.json: By talking to the rats in the Shar Temple, the player begins to notice there are specific patterns to their behaviour. Communication with them is difficult as they are resistant to your presence and make cryptic statements. After engaging with the rats a few times, the player/there companions might note that there's something odd going on (to be unveiled later if they start killing rats)
- SHA_LastJusticiar_RatsPanicked.json: After killing some of the rats, they become more panicked and aggressive - but also a litte more lucid- something the companions may pick up on. The may start to remember things -fragments of a memory, or a name on the tip of their tongue.
- SHA_LastJusticiar_JusticiarAppears.json: After killing the final rat during the Ultimatum stage, one of the final rats returns to its humanoid form as Lyrthindor,  the Last Justiciar. He's furious that the player has blown his cover, and quickly turns hostile.

- Player: Hold up your hands in peace. (node 51)

context: You’ve been clearing a rat‑infested area beneath Orthon’s lair; as you kill more rodents their scattered memories are beginning to merge into a single bargaining intelligence — the lingering essence of the last Dark Justiciar. Players who accepted Orthon’s quest to find a Dark Justiciar may recognize that the Justiciar’s consciousness is hiding among these rats. Off‑screen allies or other plot beats (companions, Halsin, Auntie Ethel, the tadpole, etc.) might be nearby but aren’t part of this immediate exchange. In this scene the swarm is attempting to parley (you hear squeaking), but if you repeatedly press them instead of accepting a truce they will abandon bargaining and become hostile, possibly culminating in a fight or the final rat reverting to the Justiciar.
